text: The test helper selects expectLinkOpenInNewTab for the same-site _blank link outside single-page mode. A later comment in the same test still says it opens in the same tab. The assertions and helper invocation express the new-tab expectation, so this is a comment update proposal, not a demonstrated navigation defect. For this test, keep the tab-destination description aligned with the helper and preserve the separate external-browser assertions. This is static source evidence. No runtime, build or live accessibility validation was run. Full bug and review discussion remains pending.
title: Match link-test comments to the actual new-tab helper contract
